'''Vladimir Ivanovich Dmitriev''' ({{langx|ru|Владимир Иванович Дмитриев}}; 20 October 1932 – 24 November 2020) was a Russian scientist in the field of [[mathematical physics]], [[Doctor of Sciences|doctor of physical and mathematical sciences]] (1967), and professor at the [[MSU Faculty of Computational Mathematics and Cybernetics]] (CMC MSU). He served as head of the Laboratory of Mathematical Physics and as deputy dean of the faculty.<ref name="CSObit">{{cite web |url=https://cs.msu.ru/news/3416 |title=Professor Vladimir Ivanovich Dmitriev has passed away |publisher=Faculty of Computational Mathematics and Cybernetics, Moscow State University |access-date=6 November 2025 |archive-date=24 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210124165035/https://cs.msu.ru/news/3416 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Dmitriev graduated from secondary school in [[Baku]] in 1950 and from the [[Moscow State University Faculty of Physics|Faculty of Physics]] at [[Moscow State University]] in 1955.<ref name="Letopis">{{cite web |url=https://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/8263 |title=V. I. Dmitriev |website=Chronicle of Moscow University |access-date=6 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250226152039/https://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/8263 |archive-date=26 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref>
In 1959 he completed postgraduate studies and defended his candidate (Ph.D.) dissertation on “Electromagnetic fields applied to problems of aero-electrical exploration,” supervised by [[Andrey Tikhonov (mathematician)|Andrey N. Tikhonov]].<ref name="Grigoriev2010">{{cite book |last=Grigoriev |first=E. A. |title=Faculty of Computational Mathematics and Cybernetics: History and Modernity |publisher=Moscow University Press |year=2010 |language=ru |isbn=978-5-211-05838-5}}</ref>
He received the degree of Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences in 1967 for the dissertation “Electromagnetic fields in inhomogeneous media” and was awarded the title of professor in 1969.<ref name="Professors2005">{{cite book |title=Professors of Moscow University: 1755–2004. Biographical Dictionary |publisher=Moscow University Press |year=2005 |language=ru |isbn=978-5-211-05006-8}}</ref>

From 1960 to 1962, he worked as scientific secretary of the Magnetic Laboratory of the [[A. A. Baikov Institute of Metallurgy and Materials Science]]. In 1962 he joined the [[Kurchatov Institute]] as a senior researcher.<ref name="Barashkov2021">{{cite pdf |last=Barashkov |first=I. S. |title=Vladimir Ivanovich Dmitriev – Outstanding Soviet and Russian Scientist |url=https://ems-2021.ocean.ru/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/Barashkov-I.S._Vladimir-Ivanovich-Dmitriev-vydajushhijsya-sovetskij-i-rossijskij-uchjonyj.pdf |access-date=6 November 2025 |language=ru |website=EMS-2021 Conference Proceedings}}</ref>

From 1962 to 1982 Dmitriev worked at the Research Computing Centre of Moscow State University as senior researcher, head of sector, and deputy director.<ref name="Grigoriev2010"/>  
From 1982 until his death he was professor at the Department of Mathematical Physics of CMC MSU, head of its Laboratory of Mathematical Physics, and since 1986, deputy dean of the faculty.<ref name="CSObit"/>

== Research ==
Dmitriev developed mathematical methods for modelling electromagnetic fields in inhomogeneous media and contributed to inverse problems in geophysics.<ref name="Barashkov2021"/>  
He worked on the mathematical theory of antenna design, radiating systems, and electromagnetic sounding methods used in exploration geophysics and geo-electrics. His algorithms were implemented in the software library ''Electromagnetic Fields in Geophysics'' used for applied research.<ref name="Barashkov2021"/>  
He was a full member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences|Russian Academy of Natural Sciences]] (1992), where he headed the section “Applied Mathematics and Mathematical Physics.”<ref>{{cite web |title=Members of the Russian Academy of Natural Sciences |url=https://raen.info/ |access-date=6 November 2025 |language=ru}}</ref>
He also served as an editor for ''Applied Mathematics and Informatics'' (CMC MSU proceedings), the journal ''Computational Mathematics and Modeling'', and on editorial boards of other scientific periodicals.<ref name="Grigoriev2010"/>

== Teaching ==
At CMC MSU Dmitriev taught courses on ''Differential Equations'', ''Mathematical Modelling Systems'', and ''Inverse Problems in Geophysics''.<ref name="Grigoriev2010"/>

== Recognition ==
Dmitriev’s biography appears in reference works such as ''Professors of Moscow University: 1755–2004'' and ''Faculty of Computational Mathematics and Cybernetics: History and Modernity'', which document his contributions to mathematical physics and computational geophysics.<ref name="Grigoriev2010"/><ref name="Professors2005"/>

== Awards ==
* [[Order of Honour (Russia)|Order of Honour]] (2003)<ref name="CSObit"/>  
* [[Order of the Badge of Honour]] (1980)<ref name="CSObit"/>  
* [[USSR State Prize]] (1976)<ref name="Professors2005"/>  
* USSR Council of Ministers Prize (1986)<ref name="Professors2005"/>  
* [[Lomonosov Prize]] (1983)<ref name="Grigoriev2010"/>  
* [[Honoured Scientist of the Russian Federation]] (1993)<ref name="Professors2005"/>  
* Honoured Professor of Moscow State University (1994)<ref name="Grigoriev2010"/>  
* Three gold and one silver [[VDNKh]] medals<ref name="Professors2005"/>

== Selected publications ==
Dmitriev authored more than 300 scientific papers and 27 books and textbooks, including:  
* ''Differential Equations'' (Moscow: Argamak-Media, 2016, 284 pp., ISBN 978-5-00-024049-6).<ref>{{cite book |last=Dmitriev |first=V. I. |title=Differential Equations |publisher=Argamak-Media |year=2016 |isbn=978-5-00-024049-6}}</ref>
* ''Marine Electromagnetic Soundings'' (Moscow: Argamak-Media, 2014, 192 pp., ISBN 978-5-00-024022-9).<ref>{{cite book |last=Dmitriev |first=V. I. |title=Marine Electromagnetic Soundings |publisher=Argamak-Media |year=2014 |isbn=978-5-00-024022-9}}</ref>
* ''Inverse Problems of Geophysics'' (Moscow: MAKS Press, 2012, 340 pp.).<ref>{{cite book |last=Dmitriev |first=V. I. |title=Inverse Problems of Geophysics |publisher=MAKS Press |year=2012 |language=ru}}</ref>
He also co-edited ''Numerical Methods in Mathematical Physics'' (Moscow State University, 1998).<ref name="Grigoriev2010"/>
